name: Piggy But Better [BETA]
desc:
Game is still in a beta state, so please excuse us if the game is a tad bit buggy!

Have you ever wondered what Piggy would be like if the game had its models redesigned again? If the House map wasn't a direct rip of the Granny map? If Carnival was harder?

Well, imagine no more! Go through the story of Piggy once more, this time with better features and new skins.

Do you have what it takes to escape the new Piggy and uncover the mysteries surrounding the beast?

Shutdown = update

Current game version: v1.3.2
